rows.canonical: PagedRadixKVPool (radix prefix tree bound to paged KV blocks)
rows.definition: radixkv.PagedRadixKVPool (internal/radixkv/paged_binding.go) binds a RadixAttention prefix tree to reference-counted physical page blocks in a ctxmmu.KVPool: a prefix hit binds the cached block chain into a stream's PagedBlockTable (refcount++) instead of cloning KV tensors; NewPagedRadixKVPoolWithTree wraps an existing tree. The in-kernel device planner's paged prefix ledger (internal/agent/inkernel_paged_prefix.go) is its production consumer.
rows.distinction: It is the prefix-tree-to-page-block BINDING, NOT the model.PagedKVPool float block allocator nor the ctxmmu.KVPool physical page pool it draws from.
